trickyParts: T5 refinement (architect, overrides plan): the boot repair removes every child tree that holds no process -- queued, launch-failed, or active with no locator (spliced from admission.active too) -- not only queued ones; named adoptOwnerlessChildTrees. It runs before enableLaunches() so reconcileAdmission cannot demote/relaunch an active-no-locator child as a root in the same boot.

publishDesignApproved was generalized into publishWakeEffects(effects, envoyPublish, describeFailure) in api/routes/issues.ts; satisfyGateOff and the boot child-adopted publishes share the one 404-silent loop.
The orphan log line names the nearest ancestor tree via treeFor (reducers.ts) when liveAncestorTree says none is live, so lingering/closed parents are named with their status.

A stale root-architect role claim a launch-failed child tree may leave in state.roles is inert (no locator, no resumable session); the parent's first sub-architect spawn launches fresh over it. Documented in adoptOwnerlessChildTrees's comment, not removed.

Boot repair on the rig: stop the daemon, give the child a queued tree + admission.queue entry in state.json, restart; expect the log line 'removed the queued root tree for <child> at boot: it is a child of <root> (<root> is active) ... (LEGION-57)' and a child-adopted wake in the architect pane.
